name: Deplixo
description:
Deplixo lets you deploy web apps to a live, shareable URL directly from Claude. Describe what you want — a calculator, a landing page, a fitness tracker — and it gets built and shipped in one step. No terminal, no hosting setup, no account required. Apps support HTML, CSS, and JavaScript with multi-file projects, persistent cloud storage, AI-powered features, and real-time data sync across devices. Update apps by asking for changes. Every deploy returns a live URL you can 
share immediately.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Deplixo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Deplixo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.deplixo.com/.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Deplixo MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deplixo provides these MCP tools: deplixo_deploy and deplixo_read_source.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Deplixo?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Deplixo in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
Deplixo does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
Deplixo is developed by Brightwing Systems LLC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
